raw.details:
Overview

2 Problems. Solve Both. Beat the Clock.

CodeSprint is a timed online coding competition organised by RANKUP for participants who want to test their programming, problem-solving, logical thinking, and coding skills through real coding problems.

Challenge Format

• 2 coding problems
• Both problems are mandatory
• Limited time to complete the challenge
• Actual code submission and execution
• Multiple programming languages supported
• Individual participation
• Online mode
• Automated evaluation through test cases

Programming Languages

Participants can use supported programming languages such as C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript, and

other languages available on the competition platform.

How It Works

• Register for CodeSprint
• Access the coding challenge during the scheduled contest window
• Attempt both programming problems
• Submit your solutions through the coding environment
• Solutions are automatically evaluated using test cases
• Rankings are determined based on successful solutions and overall coding performance

Rewards & Recognition

Top 10 Performers

• Free .xyz domain for 1 year
• Certificate of Achievement

Rank 1

•  AI Interview Voucher from InterviewBuddy

Rank 2

• 90% AI Interview Discount Voucher from InterviewBuddy

Rank 3

• 90% AI Interview Discount Voucher from InterviewBuddy

Eligible Participants

• 10% Discount Coupon for InterviewBuddy Expert-Driven Sessions
• Certificate of Participation

Important

Both coding problems are mandatory. Participants should attempt and submit solutions for both problems within the allotted contest time.

InterviewBuddy rewards will be distributed to the respective eligible recipients after the competition.

All prizes and certificates will be released within 2 days after the event.

Organised by RANKUP

Your Skills. Your Rank. Your Journey.
